title: EvaluationClaw Executable Agent Task Package
description: ALE-style executable task package metadata for professional, VM-backed, GUI, Docker, and long-horizon agent benchmark tasks.

capability_target.description: The capability target being measured, not just the concrete task title.

environment_requirements.description: Runtime, OS, VM, GUI, software, network, licensing, image build, and resource assumptions.

image_build.description: Optional custom Docker image build config for docker_workspace tasks when no suitable Hub image exists. Supported fields include enabled, base_image, system_packages/apt_packages, python_packages/pip_packages, node_packages/npm_packages, cran_packages/r_packages, bioconductor_packages/bioc_packages, julia_packages, conda_packages/conda_channels, cargo_packages, go_packages, gem_packages, composer_packages, apk_packages, dnf_packages, yum_packages, pacman_packages, install_steps, commands, dockerfile, context_files, tag, rebuild, and build_timeout.

vm_provisioning.description: Optional cloud-init provisioning config for VM-backed tasks when a base OS image exists but task software is not installed. Supported fields include enabled, strategy, apt_packages/system_packages, pip_packages/python_packages, snap_packages, cran_packages/r_packages, bioconductor_packages/bioc_packages, julia_packages, conda_packages/conda_channels, cargo_packages, go_packages, gem_packages, composer_packages, apk_packages, dnf_packages, yum_packages, pacman_packages, install_steps, commands, desktop_bridge_install_command, and desktop_bridge_start_command.

visible_inputs.description: Instructions, files, assets, datasets, URLs, and public session state visible to the target agent.

hidden_references.description: Runner-private references, evaluator files, expected artifacts, checksums, or hidden oracle notes.

output_contract.description: Expected artifacts, output schema, final state, and constraints to check after the run.

execution.description: Setup, run, and evaluate contract for the environment or bridge.

evaluation.description: Evaluation method, checks, score range, and pass/partial/fail criteria.

artifact_collection.description: Paths, logs, screenshots, renders, notebooks, traces, and other artifacts to save.

trajectory_requirements.description: Expected/forbidden tool use and trace audit rules.

resource_provenance.description: Sources, licenses, and construction notes for source-backed tasks.
